criterion: Endpoint policy logic is reviewed separately from capacity approval
why_it_matters: Endpoint-policy support must not silently approve buffer capacity
required_evidence_or_check: Review packet states policy logic and separately states that no capacity is approved
pass_condition: Reviewer confirms endpoint policy is explicit and capacity remains unapproved
fail_or_defer_condition: If policy text implies or assumes a capacity value then defer
notes: CYC50 logic is not capacity approval.

criterion: CYC50 is treated as policy-only logic
why_it_matters: CYC50 is structurally useful for anti-fake-flexibility but is not an opening or closing quantity by itself
required_evidence_or_check: Check that the packet distinguishes initial-equals-terminal logic from exact tonnes
pass_condition: Reviewer confirms policy basis only and any quantity remains unapproved
fail_or_defer_condition: If exact numerical stock levels are implied without separate approval then defer
notes: This criterion keeps policy review separate from quantity review.

why_it_matters: Endpoint policy must be tied to the correct store class and configuration
required_evidence_or_check: Check store class and C0/C1 applicability in the packet
pass_condition: Reviewer confirms where the policy applies and where it does not
fail_or_defer_condition: If applicability is unclear or mixed across store classes then defer
notes: C1S may reuse the policy only as an overlay.
